messages:
elena: Heads up — after the v2026.3 rollout to us-east-1 there are reports of garbled tokens in chat responses (lots of � and repeated subwords).

samir: seeing it on canaries too, started ~2m after deploy. latency fine, but token stream corrupted. attaching short dump.

elena: example from prod: 
```
User: summarize pricing tiers
Model: gptx-v1
Response chunk: "The pricing is 3.��.��.99 per month. "
```

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Incident created — TAG: model-stream-encoding-anom — Severity: P1 — Paging oncall.

oncall-bot: Oncall Samir (primary) paged (rotation: infra-weekend). Please acknowledge with `ack`.

samir: ack. I’m on it.

maria: adding context — we promoted a weight artifact with new tokenizer-mapping file (vocab_aliases.json) as part of the release. CI passed, but I noticed the deploy manifest pinned the older tokenizer config on a subset of hosts.

elena: that aligns — mismatch between weightset tag and tokenizer mapping would explain the subword corruption.

kevin: are customers impacted? any 5xxs?

elena: no 5xxs, but increased user complaints in support. Some long-running chat sessions show streaming corruption — UX broken.

samir: investigating rollout graph, looks like 30% of traffic hit the new artifact set, rest on previous. Canary alerting missed because encoding degrades not latency.

samir: quick check: `curl -s http://deploy-service/api/artifacts?env=prod&region=us-east-1` shows two aliases pointing to different tokenizer manifests for same model tag.

maria: confirmed — artifact tag `gptx-v1-2026-3` -> weights: wset-88, tokenizer: tok-77. But some nodes pulled tok-76 (old) due to stale cache.

elena: mitigation plan: 1) flip feature flag to route all traffic to previous stable artifact (hot rollback flag), 2) roll back tokenizer mappings on nodes that pulled wrong config, 3) evict caches. Which is fastest?

samir: flip flag first (lowest blast radius). Can someone flip `ff/model-rollout-gptx` to `off`?

maria: I can flip in 30s. Doing it now.

maria: flipped `ff/model-rollout-gptx` -> off :white_check_mark: (routing to stable). Traffic draining to stable over 10-15s.

kevin: verified telemetry — within a minute error reports dropped ~90%. Good.

elena: next: force tokenizer config reload on the nodes that cached tok-76. I’ll run the rollout repair script: `scripts/repair_tokenizer_cache --model gptx-v1 --region us-east-1`.

samir: be careful — script restarts grpc workers on node. Coordinate with oncall.

elena: understood — I'll do a rolling restart with 1 node at a time. Starting with cluster us-east-1-a.

oncall-bot: Reminder: page policy requires notifying support/CS for any customer-impacting rollback.

elena: ping @support-leads — we’re rolling back model rollout in us-east-1 due to tokenizer mismatch causing garbled outputs. No 5xxs; user-facing quality degradation. ETA for full mitigation ~ 12 minutes.

incident-bot: Update logged to incident: mitigation step 1 complete (feature flag off).

samir: rolling restart complete for us-east-1-a, tokenizer mappings now consistent (tok-77 everywhere). Running smoke tests.

elena: smoke: all good, sample prompts show normal tokenization.

kevin: can we safely re-enable rollout after fixing release pipeline to prevent partial tokenizer pulls?

maria: need two fixes before re-enable: 1) ensure artifact server atomic publish (so tokenizer+weights published together), 2) invalidate CDN cache for tokenizer manifests on deploy. I'll open an urgent PR and a short-lived guard: prevent partial artifact promotion.

samir: agreed. For now keep flag off. I'll keep pager open until we confirm no regressions for 30m.

elena: logging incident notes and customer-impact tags. Suggested severity downgrade to P2 after rollback success? Ops, what do you think?

oncall-bot: Please follow postmortem template if incident remains open >4h.

kevin: fine to drop to P2 after 30m of clean metrics; no major customers lost data.

maria: filing PR (WIP): "atomic-publish-tokenizer-weights" — will request expedited review.

incident-bot: Timeline: 0m — deploy completed; 2m — encoding anomalies observed; 5m — pager created/ack; 7m — feature flag flipped; 12m — rolling restarts completed; 14m — smoke tests pass; 15m — traffic back to stable.

samir: adding TODOs to incident: run token-level eval set across regions, add alert for token-entropy anomalies (not just latency/errors), add postmortem owner (maria).

elena: thanks everyone. I'll post a short customer note for CS: "We observed a model artifact mismatch that caused degraded tokenization for a subset of users; traffic was rolled back and corrections deployed. No data loss. Follow-up postmortem to come."

incident-bot: Incident assigned: owner=maria, severity=P2 (pending 30m clean).

maria: taking owner. will coordinate postmortem and PR.

kevin: good catch and quick rollback. :thumbsup:

elena: closing thread here, will update incident doc once postmortem is ready.
